title: Salsa Dancing Beginner Basics Tutorial Video

method.teacher_system: The teachers demonstrate basic salsa footwork facing away from the camera, break down counts and weight shifts in small chunks, and gradually add forward, side, and cumbia variations.
method.signature: They face away from the camera so the learner can directly mirror their left and right sides without flipping.

practices.what: Demonstrate the basic in place step facing away from the camera using the left foot first.
Count 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 while explaining why step 4 and 8 are held without a step.
Break down the forward and back basic step slowly with weight shifts.
Recap the basic in place and forward and back steps together in repeated follow-along rounds.
Introduce the side to side basic step starting on the left foot.
Break down the open break step going back and forward.
Teach cumbia steps going back and forward with side weight shifts.

adaptations.adjustment: pause and practice the weight shift alone before continuing
look down at the steps first to get used to where you are going, then look up later
rewind or pause the video to practice before moving on

beliefs.belief: Do not worry about style, details, or body movement on your first time; just focus on the basic steps.
It is better to focus on the steps first, and then add more complex elements later.
It is okay to feel robotic at first, and with practice, the movement will improve.

feelings.response: The teacher tells the learner not to worry about details like body movement or flavor, and to just focus on the steps.
The teacher tells the learner that it is okay to feel robotic, and that with practice, the movement will improve.
The teacher acknowledges that they do not want to add too much and overwhelm the learner.

moments.says: The teacher introduces himself and his partner, and explains that this video is for absolute beginners to learn basic salsa steps without needing a partner.
The teacher asks the learner to pause and notice the weight shift, emphasizing the importance of feeling the movement.
The teacher gives the learner permission to pause and practice the current step before moving on to the next one.
The teacher reassures the learner that it is okay to not worry about details like body movement or flavor, and to just focus on the steps.
The teacher advises the learner to look up, but acknowledges that it is okay to look down at their feet while they are still learning.
The teacher reminds the learner that it is okay to rewind or pause the video to practice before moving on.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and encouraged to practice at their own pace.

struggles.theme: getting confused by facing opposite directions

clicked.theme: facing away from the camera makes it so much easier to follow
breaking things down into small clear steps

meant.theme: feeling confident enough to finally try salsa dancing

method.limits: Partner connection and hand styling are not shown because this tutorial focuses entirely on solo footwork.
